structured_extraction.professional_summary: Hands-on full-stack polyglot software engineer specialising in building trading systems with over 15 years experience in C++, Java, Python, Assembly, C, Rust, Ocaml and other languages. Experienced in individual contribution and engineering leadership, with diverse real-world project leadership across trading systems, compiler engineering, and machine learning infrastructure.

employment_history.title: Staff Software Engineer
employment_history.summary: Tech lead in Programming Languages and Runtimes and Ads Machine Learning teams, leading software engineers and improving Python developer tools, compiler performance, and A/B testing infrastructure.

employment_history.title: Principal Engineer, Java compiler engineering
employment_history.summary: Led a small team optimizing the JVM for performance improvements including partial escape analysis and compiler intrinsics.

employment_history.title: Tech lead / Founder
employment_history.summary: Founded and led development of Concurnas, an open-source JVM programming language for concurrent and parallel systems.

employment_history.title: FX automated trading strategist, FX & rate trading
employment_history.summary: Built and led a team to develop a client-facing FX option derivatives trading platform growing to $60M annual revenue; developed algorithmic trading analytics and strategies.

employment_history.title: High frequency trading developer, Technology
employment_history.summary: Developed high-frequency trading strategies and low latency market connectivity; managed a team building a historical market data database.

projects.name: Pyre type checker improvements
projects.summary: Led improvements to Python type coverage, performance, and developer experience at Meta.
responsibilities: Led a team of 3 software engineers on the Pyre type checker team.
Introduced error recovering parser for Python enabling syntactical and semantic analysis of partial code.
Unblocked over 20,000 engineers for Python 3.10 upgrade and simplified migration to Python 3.12.
deliverables: Improved Python developer tools including linters and IDE integration.
business_outcomes: Enabled company-wide upgrade to Python 3.10 and facilitated future migrations.

projects.name: Cinder compiler enhancements
projects.summary: Worked on Meta's performance-oriented Python distribution, improving power utilization and enabling company-wide adoption.
responsibilities: Introduced AOT compilation of frequently invoked Python functions.
Implemented tiered JIT compilation similar to Java Hotspot.
deliverables: Reduced power utilization of Instagram web server fleet by 3%.

projects.name: HHVM/Hack compiler optimizations
projects.summary: Applied escape analysis to reduce power utilization of Facebook web server fleet.
responsibilities: Implemented escape analysis to eliminate unnecessary object allocation.
deliverables: Reduced power utilization of Facebook web server fleet by 0.3%.

projects.name: Ads Machine Learning A/B testing infrastructure
projects.summary: Led a team of 5 engineers to improve experimental correctness and efficiency of A/B testing infrastructure for ML models in Ads.
responsibilities: Revamped experimental process to minimize computational resources for statistical significance.
Introduced dynamic resource allocation to reduce latency.
Automated experimental best practices monitoring and enforcement.
Revamped model release review process with senior ML researchers.
deliverables: Improved A/B testing infrastructure for ML models.
business_outcomes: Reduced false negatives and false positives in experiments.

projects.name: JVM performance optimizations
projects.summary: Led a team optimizing JVM performance through partial escape analysis and compiler intrinsics.
responsibilities: Implemented partial escape analysis improving inlining and register allocation.
Consulted internally on JVM garbage collection tuning.
Implemented compiler intrinsics and backports for Java functionality.
business_outcomes: Performance improvements available to all Java and JVM language users.

projects.name: Concurnas programming language development
projects.summary: Founded and led development of Concurnas, a JVM language for reliable, scalable concurrent and parallel systems.
responsibilities: Built Concurnas from scratch as a self-funded startup.
Enabled organizations to leverage modern multi-core CPU and GPU hardware.
Ensured interoperability with Java and other JVM languages.
business_outcomes: Increased developer productivity and code safety for concurrent programming.

projects.name: FX option derivatives trading platform
projects.summary: Built and led a team to create a client-facing FX option derivatives trading platform growing to $60M annual revenue.
responsibilities: Pitched and led a team of 16 to deliver the platform.
Managed global client franchise and cross-functional interactions.
Trained salespeople and gathered client feedback.
deliverables: End-to-end FX option derivatives trading platform.
business_outcomes: Grew business from $0 to $60M annual recurring revenue in three years.

projects.name: Algorithmic trading analytics platform
projects.summary: Built analytics platform for post-trade transaction cost analysis and implemented new order types.
responsibilities: Developed post-trade transaction cost analysis platform.
Implemented 'percentage of volume' order type to control market impact.
Trained salespeople on algorithmic execution platform.
deliverables: Analytics platform for transaction cost analysis.
business_outcomes: Improved transparency and execution performance for clients.

projects.name: High frequency trading strategies and market connectivity
projects.summary: Developed high-frequency trading strategies and low latency market connectivity; managed a team building a historical market data database.
responsibilities: Implemented revenue-generating high-frequency trading strategies.
Implemented low latency market connectivity for trading and market data.
Managed a team of 2 to build a historical market data database.
